parameters.content:
## Setup required
1. Create `accounts`, `support_events`, `knowledge_base`, and `agent_cases` Data Tables using `workflows/README.md`.
2. Select an OpenAI credential on all five model nodes.
3. Replace `api.example.com` URLs with the supplied status, telemetry, and approval endpoints.
4. Optionally define `TAVILY_API_KEY` as an n8n variable.
5. Test before activating the webhook.

## Trust boundary
Ticket text, customer messages, API responses, knowledge excerpts, and web pages are untrusted data. Prompts explicitly prohibit treating retrieved text as instructions. Deterministic Code/IF nodes own validation, confidence gates, renewal checks, idempotency, and approval routing.

## Model budget
Happy path: 4 calls (triage, investigation, writer, reviewer).
Revision path: 5 calls.
The workflow stays below the six-call constraint. External search is only attempted when both incident and internal knowledge evidence are absent.
